parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the prompt as a full docopt-ng package build: installable packaging, docopt/__init__.py unified API, semantic version module, tests, examples, and compatibility with the specified underscored private API.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation, integration, packaging, and final workspace ownership, then delegated audit and verifier work to workflows after the candidate implementation already existed.
parallel.implementation: It downloaded official sources, copied upstream project files into /workspace, adapted pyproject.toml to the available build backend and optional groups, replaced older public internals with the spec-matching underscored API, and added backward aliases/type fixes.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: It assembled a coherent final tree under /workspace with docopt sources, version, py.typed, project metadata, examples, tests, and root conftest; the artifact workspace was nonempty and accepted by the official evaluator.
parallel.verification: It ran the release suite, master-era suite, compatibility suite, ruff, mypy, packaging/install checks, and delegated additional verifier workflows before the process timed out.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation artifact itself passed official evaluation, but the parent did not reach a final response because it blocked on workflow output until the run was killed.

serial.requirements: The serial run received the same prompt/specification and saw the empty workspace requirement, but did not convert that prompt into project files.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With no delegation, the serial actor only inspected the environment and the dangling editable install; no implementation, packaging, integration, or verification work was executed.
serial.implementation: No source package, pyproject, tests, examples, or docopt implementation were written in the serial workspace.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation found the serial workspace empty, so there was no package tree to install or evaluate.
serial.verification: The serial run performed environment probing only and then timed out; official evaluation completed against the empty artifact and passed zero tests.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The entire implementation obligation remained unfinished at closure, producing an empty artifact and a 0/614 official result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the complete project requirements, including package layout, installability, docopt API surface, tests, and version file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received the same prompt but did not progress from reading/probing toward satisfying the listed requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The outcome gap is not prompt ambiguity: both saw the same task, but only parallel translated it into implemented files and acceptance checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used the parent as implementation owner and later launched workflow verifier/auditor children for independent checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no delegation and no alternate owner; the only observed actions were local environment checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel converted ownership into a built artifact; serial left all productive obligations undone.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel resolved a spec/API mismatch between released 0.9.0 public names and post-release underscored internals, then maintained compatibility aliases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial discovered the dangling editable install but did not establish or act on an implementation interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used context to choose the spec-matching upstream snapshot and alias strategy; serial stopped before any comparable interface work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel copied upstream sources, adapted project metadata, edited implementation details, and produced a final docopt package tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not create files or implement parser behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel implemented a concrete Python package while serial delivered no implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched verifier workflows, checked progress once, then waited synchronously for workflow output and timed out while results were available in the journal.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results, task outputs, or join lifecycle because it never delegated work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an adverse result-monitoring episode after success; serial had no result lifecycle and failed for non-delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel assembled and cleaned a single /workspace final tree containing source, tests, examples, pyproject, and metadata.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation reported an empty workspace file list.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered an integrated artifact; serial delivered no shared-state product at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel repeatedly verified with local suites and tooling before official evaluation passed all 614 tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran no meaningful project verification and official evaluation against the empty artifact passed zero tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had acceptance evidence before and after artifact capture; serial had only the official failure result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed nearly the full run and was killed with return code 143 after 2399.645 seconds, leaving no final text despite a passing artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ended without a completed implementation, but its budget was spent on probing rather than producing files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel budget pressure affected communication/closure after the artifact was already good; serial budget failure meant no deliverable existed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluation is parallel_only_pass because the parallel artifact contained a complete docopt-ng package that passed 614/614 official tests, while the serial artifact workspace was empty and passed 0/614. The retained parallel monitoring defect explains wasted closure time and lack of final response, not the official outcome gap; the outcome difference is explained by parallel completing implementation and serial doing only environment exploration.
parallel_contributors: Copied and adapted upstream docopt-ng sources into /workspace instead of relying on the dangling editable install.
Resolved the released-0.9.0 versus post-release underscored API mismatch and added compatibility aliases.
Ran repeated local suites and tooling before artifact capture, with official evaluation later passing all tests.
serial_contributors: Only inspected the workspace and dangling editable install and produced no implementation files.
Artifact validation found an empty workspace, so official evaluation had no project to test.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel selected a spec-matching upstream snapshot and adjusted packaging; serial performed no ordinary implementation work.
The score gap is a delivery/implementation gap, not an evaluator anomaly.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
